belowGroundEvidence: The model's y = 0 is the mean 3DBAG ground (1.397 m NAP) of thirteen pands along a 120 m front; the Raadhuisstraat pavement falls about 0.33 m from the Keizersgracht end to nr 43-45 (3DBAG ground per pand, AHN4 DTM), so the walls, piers and shopfront plinths start at y = -0.5 instead of hanging over the low end.
